label: Your MYKEYNEST guide
minimize: Minimize the guide to use the page
error: Your progress could not be saved. Try again or skip the guide.
hint: Just looking around: Next continues without creating anything or sending an invitation. You can try it later.
create_text: The Add button saves an account you already use: its website, your sign-in name and password. For now, you can simply continue exploring.
create_form: This form holds the access name, website, sign-in name and current password. It does not change the password on the website. You can fill it in later and continue with Next.
extension_title: Your extension, at the top right
extension_text: The MYKEYNEST icon sits to the right of your browser’s address bar. Missing in Chrome? Open the Extensions menu (puzzle piece), then pin MYKEYNEST. It gives you access to your credentials and fills sign-in fields.
extension_dialog: This button opens the indicated website and fills authorized fields with the extension. You can simply look at this window and continue the guide without launching sign-in.
share_title: Two ways to share an access
share_text: The Shares page lets you choose a recipient and several accesses. A card’s small share button opens quick sharing. Both paths are shown here; no invitation is needed to continue.
share_form: This form lets you choose a recipient, accesses and permission to reveal the password. You do not need to send anything during this tour: Next continues the guide.
share_quick: Quick sharing applies to the access selected on the card. It lets you choose the recipient and their permissions. You can leave this form empty and continue with Next.
settings_title: Make the extension work your way
settings_text: Three modes are available: classic opening, suggestions below fields and discreet mode without automatic popups. Settings apply to each installation. You can keep your current preferences and finish the tour.
settings_waiting: This page presents the extension and its settings: classic opening, suggestions below fields and discreet mode. Options appear when the extension is detected and connected. Nothing needs changing to finish the tour.
settings_navigation: Settings are under More → Extension. The menu is open to show you the way. This page presents suggestions below fields and discreet mode; you can also finish the tour here.
done_text: You now know your vault, sign-in and sharing tools. You can replay this guide anytime from your profile menu by choosing Replay the guide.
